Title (verbatim): "RAG：先找資料，再根據證據回答"
Subtitle (verbatim): "R 檢索 → A 加入提示 → G 生成"
Figure and text specification: Upper small input bubble "怎麼申請長照？" leads to large three-stage diagram. R column heading "R｜找相關片段": document library with several sheets, selected amber excerpt card "[L1-2] 申請流程", subtitle "文件集合 → 相關片段". A column heading "A｜把證據放進提示": visible stacked prompt slots labelled "指示：依資料回答", "問題：怎麼申請？", "證據：[L1-2] 申請流程". G column heading "G｜寫出回答與來源": blue language-model box transforms prompt into answer bubble "可撥打 1966 [L1-2]". A clear thin return citation-check arrow from "[L1-2]" in answer to the same retrieved amber excerpt, labelled "開原文核對". Under main flow two concise paired concept notes with small meaningful icons: locked model parameters "資料在回答時加入，非重新訓練"; missing evidence document "找不到依據，就說資料不足". Bottom takeaway "RAG 讓答案可追溯；找錯片段或讀錯內容，仍會答錯。" Page "01 / 04".
